purpose: Define study-only recipe metadata for filling normalized cube volumes with mathematical architectural shape grammars and semantic role outputs.

field_contract.cube_id: Stable id for the cube zoo specimen.
field_contract.math_family: Human-readable mathematical family or construction type.
field_contract.formula_or_parametric_definition: Machine-readable formula notes, expressions, or algorithm steps. Study metadata only.
field_contract.coordinate_space: Must declare normalized_cube coordinates with x, y, z in [-1, 1].
field_contract.parameters: Named tunable values for the formula.
field_contract.radius_rules: How radius, thickness, threshold, or field bands should be interpreted.
field_contract.connector_logic: Object with north, south, east, west, floor, and ceiling connector entries.
field_contract.sharpness_or_smoothness: How rounded, sharp, bendy, cellular, or angular the form should be.
field_contract.symmetry: Symmetry, repetition, mirroring, or intentional asymmetry notes.
field_contract.layer_role: Which grammar layers this cube primarily exercises.
field_contract.architectural_role: Architecture roles this cube might eventually serve.
field_contract.allowed_child_patterns: Pattern families that may attach to sockets, panels, or boundaries.
field_contract.plot_shape_refs: Stable ids from plot_shape_taxonomy_v0. Cube recipes reference shared plot-shape families instead of privately owning math primitives.
field_contract.geometry_outputs: Required geometry output categories, even when arrays are empty before generation.
field_contract.semantic_outputs: Required semantic role output categories, even when arrays are empty before generation.
field_contract.preview_requirements: Required debug previews before deeper generation.
field_contract.future_profile_behavior: Potential height/profile/depth behavior. No implementation implied.
field_contract.shape_category: One of allowed_shape_categories for grouped review surfaces.
field_contract.detail_level: Current depth of implementation: shallow, medium, or deep.
field_contract.generation_readiness: Current readiness gate: research, previewed, semantic_mapped, or mesh_candidate.
field_contract.building_generation_uses: Building/module uses this shape can support.
field_contract.object_generation_uses: Object/prop uses this shape can support.
field_contract.ornament_generation_uses: Ornament/panel uses this shape can support.
field_contract.semantic_role_mappings: Human-readable mapping from geometry categories into generation semantics.
field_contract.utility_scores: 0-5 utility/risk score matrix for curation and next-target selection.
field_contract.notes: Caveats, deferments, source restrictions, and implementation warnings.
